page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Running text in one column with a drop-cap initial, italic headings set centred, and a catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: DE ARCHITE-CTURA.
main_text.p: Architectura, Die bawkunst / est ars do-mos & ædificia varia extruendi: Ejus Subjectum est Domus seu Ædificium, in quo tria consideranda sunt: Caussae, Species, Adjuncta.
Præcipua est defensio ab injuria cœli & tempestatum: Cujus gratia caussa Efficiens cæteras caussas ad effectum dirigit.
Lapis & lignum, duæ præcipuæ materiæ sunt. Ad has pertinent, Calx, falch & Cæmentum, kleine zer-schlagene steine damit man mawret[?].
Duæ: Alia enim publica sunt, alia privata. Publica vel sacra, vel prophana sunt. Sacra, quæ ad religionem comparata sunt, ut templa, quorum forma est vel quadrangula, vel rotunda.

head.i: Quænam ædificia comparata sunt ad defensionem?

main_text.p: Portæ & turres cum muris, aggeribus, obliquis accessibus, & aliis quibus hostium impetus arcetur.

Forum, das marckt / Aerarium, die schatzkammer / Carcer, etliche orth da die roßle gehalten werden[?] / ehe man sie zum thurnieren herauß lässt / Curia, ein rahthauß / Balneae, gemeine badstuben / Palæstræ, fechtschulen / Xysti, weite bedeckte gänge / darinn die fechter sich winters zeit üben / Portus, Meerhafen / Structuræ, gebew

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Falch" (Calx, Falch) and "mawret" are uncertain in the German, and "etliche orth da die roßle gehalten werden" in the blackletter is hard to read; these are marked [?]. The page is a division opener and has no running head. The catchword "gebew" stands below the last line at the right. Faint show-through from the other side of the leaf is not transcribed.
